title: De Profundo(Tenor version)
style: gregorian chant, latin gospel, atmospheric hymn, slow tempo, cathedral organ, children choir, solo male voice, string quartet pizzicato, hand drums, bowed bass, tape saturation, plate reverb, distant room mic, sparse opening, emotional build-up, crescendo layering, 72 bpm, reverent hope, ballade

sections.text:
[verse]
Domine, miserére nobis in imbre magno;
cor tardum ne derelínquas,
clamórem de profundo
ad lucem tuam revóca.

[verse]
In siléntio sub terra germinát spes tarda,
et nova vita nascítur.
